doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing thanks
summary: Anthony Brown thanks Elvin and Keiko for the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I believe he’s very lucky, I believe you’re very lucky, I believe everyone on this planet is lucky that Elvin Jones and Keiko Jones are here so we can enjoy your music and what you bring to our lives. So I want to say thank you for myself and thank you for everyone I know, whose music, whose life, and whose spirit you have touched. And of course, Keiko, we honor you too because we know how important, how supportive and how much you contribute to Elvin’s continuing to perform and create great music and to enrich all of our lives. Unless there is any other comment, I just want to say again, Elvin Ray Jones, Keiko Jones thank you so very much for agreeing to do this interview. We wish you continued success and health and please keep doing what you’re doing. (Question not heard, Keiko is describing sitting in NY apartment during September 11th attacks)
